description: Fear & Greed, BTC/gold, % from ATH, momentum, volatility and 24h transactions (dominance, NVT and active addresses are null without a licensed source) — use this for market-signal context. Price: 200 sats (Lightning) or $0.20 USDC on Base (x402). Sample (illustrative, not live): {"status":"success","endpoint":"btc_signals","data":{"sentiment":{"fear_greed_index":42,"fear_greed_classification":"Fear"},"market":{"btc_price_usd":97500.0,"btc_dominance_percent":null,"gold_ratio":{"gold_price_usd":2650.0,"btc_gold_ratio":36.79}},"network_activity":{"active_addresses_24h":null,"transactions_24h":450000},"valuation":{"ath_usd":126000.0,"percent_from_ath":-22.6,"nvt_ratio":null},"technicals":{"momentum_score":55,"volatility_regime":"normal"}},"metadata":{"cost_sats":200}} Pay: Call it, get HTTP 402 (or MCP payment_required) with a Lightning invoice and macaroon, pay the invoice, then retry with `Authorization: L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>`. Or pay in USDC on Base via x402: sign the 402's x402 requirement (PAYMENT-REQUIRED header, or `accepts` in the JSON body) and retry with the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (x402 v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1) header; only a 200 is settled.

l402_credential.description: Optional L402 credential '<macaroon>:<preimage_hex>' (or 'L402 <macaroon>:<preimage>') from a paid invoice or an active subscription. Omit it to receive the Lightning invoice and macaroon.

x402_payment.description: Optional x402 payment (USDC on Base): base64 PaymentPayload (v2, or v1 X-PAYMENT format) signed for accepts[0] of this tool's payment_required result. Alternative to params._meta['x402/payment']. Omit both to receive the payment requirements.
